the transition from a radioactive-powered supernova to a shock-powered supernova can be observed in a single object, and that the X-ray emission from the ejecta of SN 1987 A is dominated by the interaction of the supernova ejecta with the circumstellar medium, rather than from the radioactive decay of 56Ni, as previously thought.
